summary: All 220 files in this work unit contain formal mathematical content in Lean 4 related to statistical mechanics (random current model, Ising model, FK-percolation, Edwards-Sokal coupling, etc.). The files include: (1) main theory files with definitions, theorems, and proofs (e.g., BoundaryCurrentParity.lean, CurrentContinuityEdwardsSokal.lean, FiniteCurrentConditionalPMF.lean); (2) Check files with #print axioms commands verifying axiomatic dependencies of theorems (e.g., CheckBoundaryCurrentParity.lean); (3) utility files with supporting definitions and lemmas (e.g., BoxGraphPath.lean, LeeYangPolynomial.lean, InfiniteCurrentCompactness.lean). Every file inspected contains executable Lean declarations/proofs or verification commands. No files are pure import aggregators, documentation-only, or duplicates. Per FILTER-002/004/021/025, the high evidence bar for hard exclusion is not met — all files retain unique searchable formal mathematics.
